parole.significato: unit of measure for weight equivalent to 8.5 kilograms (until 1887) or 10 kilograms (since 1887)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Estonian leivisk, leisik, from Middle Low German līvesch (pund) (literally “Livonian pound”).

From Estonian liivi, from Middle Low German [Term?] (whence also German Live (“Livonian”); the -b- > -v- occurred at this stage, -b- is original and forms with -v- are mediated through Germanic), probably originally from the endonym Livonian Līb (compare also Old East Slavic либь (libĭ), Latvian līb
